newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia rubber closes week quietly steady.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia rubber closes week quietly steady.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices closed steady in quiet trade with sentiment helped by scattered dealer covering and the wet weather, dealers said.
"Prices held steady but trades were thin due to weekend factors," a dealer at a trading firm said.
A lower close in Tokyo market did not affect the market, with producers holding back their stocks for fear of a shortage of raw materials.
There were some enquiries for latex rubber from selected Europeans factories, while Asian consumers were quiet and only monitored market levels.
Trading houses were offering the SMR 20 at 304 cents, SMR10 at 305, SMR 5 at 316, SMR L at 343, SMR CV at 363. Dealers said drum latex was offered at 232 to 236 cents.
At the close, November RSS Ones buyer was up half a cent at 310.50 cents ($1.24) a kg and November SMR 20 rose a cent tp 306.
The INRO five-day average was 238.94 Malaysian/Singapore cents per kg on Oct 10 from 239.09 on Oct 9.
The daily indicator was 239.53 against 239.09. -- Tan Lee Lee (603-230-7510) ($1=2.5055 ringgit)
